messages:
acmeops: Hey team — several of our dashboards are showing blank tiles in Console for the last ~20m. Network calls to analytics API return 503/504. Any idea? We're seeing this via the org key acme-1234 :frowning:

alex: Sorry about that. Can you paste the exact error from browser devtools or the curl? Also which graphs/date ranges are affected?

acmeops: curl shows:
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream timeout","service":"analytics-aggregator"}
It happens for wide time ranges (1w/30d) and small ones too. Only for Console dashboards, not embeddable charts.

sam-cs: escalated to eng-analytics, tagging @maya and @ollie. Created support ticket SUP-8123.

maya: looking. Any correlation with deploys? I'll check deploy bot.

ci-bot: deploy: analytics-aggregator v2.3.7 deployed 15m ago to prod (rollout 40%).

ollie: that rollout bumped query fanout for long-range requests and added an extra JOIN on the timeseries table. Could explain increased upstream latency/timeouts. Can you repro with a curl that includes the panel query payload? If you can POST the JSON to /v1/query we can trace the request from aggregator -> clickhouse.

acmeops: attaching minimal repro (sanitized):
POST /v1/query?org=acme-1234
{ "range": {"from":"2026-03-17T00:00:00Z","to":"2026-03-17T12:00:00Z"}, "metrics": ["requests.count"] }
Response: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable (upstream timeout)

maya: I'm seeing repeated 504s in the aggregator logs for that panel id=panel-9876. Upstream ClickHouse sometimes returns 200 but with 20-40s latency. Aggregator currently waits 60s before giving up. With the fanout increase we're hitting capacity.

ollie: workaround: reduce query cardinality or narrow range (last_24h) — that avoids the big JOIN and returns. We'll roll back v2.3.7 rollout to stop the regression while we prepare a fix.

alex: Thanks. ETA for rollback? Also can we show stale/cached data while origin is unhealthy? Customer asking for a temporary UX fallback.

maya: initiating rollback now. ETA ~10m to return to 100% of previous version. Also adding a config patch to enforce max_query_timeout=30s and to short-circuit extremely expensive queries for dashboards.

acmeops: confirmation — tiles are loading again for several panels :tada: Will monitor and report if anything else pops up.

sam-cs: SUP-8123 updated: root cause = analytics-aggregator v2 rollout increased query complexity -> upstream timeouts. Actions: rollback completed, push timeout cap hotfix, add canary for query latency, and postmortem.

ollie: I'll open a PR to add a routing safeguard to prefer cached dashboard views when upstream latency >250ms and to throttle high-cardinality queries from Console rendering paths.

alex: Great. We'll schedule a short postmortem and notify the customer when the write-up is ready. Marking this thread resolved for now. cc @oncall
